system.description:
Entire populations sometimes find themselves in exile Uprooted from their homeworld and cast out due to genetic differences, political ideologies, or even religious affiliations. These groups of outcasts often remain bonded together as they move from location to location seeking a new home; a task that may take generations due to the stigmas tied to exile itself.

You were raised as such an outcast, moving from place to place, seeking a new home or at least a place to rest and recover before you need to move on again. Itinerant peoples come in many flavors, but almost all face the same social stigma as an outsider that may or may not be a criminal or a danger. After all, you were exiled for a reason.

Characters raised in the Exile culture share a variety of traits in common with one another.

Astronavigator

Wandering among the stars, you pick up a few things just to make it from place to place. You gain proficiency in the Engineering or Science skill and expertise when making a skill check to find or travel to a planet, city, or other location so long as you have access to a map or chart.

Band Together

With so few allies in the universe, those you have are more precious than all the wealth of the stars. Allies who Help you need only spend a bonus action to do so. In addition, if you are within 15ft of an ally who would be reduced to 0 HP, you can expend your reaction to move adjacent to your ally and take half the damage on their behalf. This reaction always leaves your ally with at least 1hp.

Bold and Brash

People are probably going to treat you as an outcast because of your exiled status, so why hide who you truly are? Choose Intimidation or Persuasion. When using this skill while one or more allies are within 30ft, you gain an expertise die.

Exile Origin

The reason for your exile provides you one of the following benefits:

Criminal

Your people were exiled as thieves and brigands. You gain advantage on Stealth Checks to hide in crowds or in manufactured environments such as starships or cities.

Genetic

Your people were exiled due to genetic differences, whether through manipulation or evolution. Choose a heritage trait that keys off of an ability score or modifier, and then choose a different ability score or modifier for that trait. Alternatively, if you have a trait with a range or movement speed, you can increase it by 10ft or 5ft respectively.

Political

Your people were exiled over political disputes. When you make a Charisma check and roll a 5 or less you may instead treat the dice roll as a 10: this includes attack rolls and saving throws. Once you have used this ability you may not do so again until you take a short or long rest.

Religious

Your people’s faith resulted in your exile. Choose a Cleric Cantrip that you gain access to.

Warfare

Whether your people were a soldier caste thrown away when no longer needed or the losing side in a war, violence is the reason for your exile. You gain proficiency with three Weapons or Vehicles of your choosing.
